categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: outdoor products and chip business. The outdoor segment includes research, design, operation, and sales of outdoor apparel, footwear, backpacks, tents, sleeping bags, and mountaineering equipment. The chip segment focuses on touch IC design, Mini LED display driver IC design, chip packaging and testing services, and related technology solutions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies such as the 'Polar Bionic Technology Platform' for outdoor products, including innovative functional fabrics and safety outsole technologies. In chip business, it employs On-Cell single-layer touch IC technology, Mini/Micro LED active matrix display driver chips, and advanced packaging technologies like wafer-level packaging and 3D stacking. Production mainly involves outsourced manufacturing with in-house R&D and design, and chip manufacturing and packaging are outsourced to foundries and subcontractors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include outdoor enthusiasts across various age groups, with products targeting professional mountaineering, hiking, skiing, camping, and urban outdoor activities. Chip customers are mainly panel manufacturers and end-product makers in consumer electronics, automotive displays, and industrial applications. The company also serves institutional clients such as national polar expeditions, manned space missions, and oceanic scientific explorations.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with extensive retail presence across major regions including North China, South China, East China, Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, and Central China. It also has growing international markets in Mongolia, Malaysia, Nepal, UAE, Iran, Saudi Arabia, Kyrgyzstan, and North America. The chip business includes subsidiaries in South Korea and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain. For outdoor products, it focuses on design, R&D, brand marketing, and retail sales, while manufacturing is outsourced. In the chip business, it covers upstream design and downstream packaging/testing, with wafer fabrication outsourced to foundries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategically, the company emphasizes dual-core business growth in outdoor and chip sectors, focusing on technology-driven innovation and sustainable development. R&D priorities include advanced functional materials, smart outdoor equipment, Mini/Micro LED display technologies, automotive-grade chips, and integrated packaging solutions. The company also invests in green manufacturing, digital supply chain optimization, and global market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of outdoor apparel, footwear, and equipment, as well as sales of semiconductor chips and related modules. The company also earns income from technical services, licensing, and solutions in the chip segment. Sales channels include direct retail, franchise, online e-commerce platforms, and B2B group purchases.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the outdoor industry, the company is a leading domestic brand recognized for its professional, technological, and fashionable products, competing with international and local brands. In the chip sector, it is a rising player with proprietary technologies in touch IC and Mini LED driver chips, competing against established global and regional semiconductor firms. The company holds a competitive edge through vertical integration and innovation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported total revenue of approximately RMB 1.59 billion, with an 14.44% year-on-year increase. Outdoor business accounted for 86% of revenue, growing 8.91%, while chip business grew 66.56% to nearly RMB 222 million. Net profit attributable to shareholders rose 48.5% to RMB 106.6 million. The company maintains a stable asset base of about RMB 2.59 billion with ongoing investments in R&D and capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by integrating professional-grade technology, innovation, and fashion in outdoor products, supported by proprietary polar bionic technology and smart equipment. In chips, it offers advanced, patented On-Cell touch ICs and Mini LED active matrix drivers with high performance and customization. Its comprehensive supply chain integration, strong brand reputation, and commitment to sustainability provide unique value to customers.
